name: yotta-memory
description: Yuanyi (元忆) — boundary-aware, file-based memory for AI agents. File-based, zero-dependency, diff/rollback-able; FACT/PREF/BOUND/COMMIT four types (public shared / private isolated), user-level + project-level storage; v0.8 semantic search + usage feedback loop + rule-layer self-organization + psychological-log distillation (self-learning/self-evolving/self-improving).
